__purpose: Manager node spec for editable floating-point numeric constants.
label: Float

metadata.description: Produces a floating-point numeric value from config or a connected numeric input.

compatibility.rule: Connect value output to numeric parameters, math, logic, or modulation inputs.
compatibility.repairHint: Use Int when the target expects whole-number steps.

examples.title: Constant value
examples.summary: Set value=1.5 to drive a downstream number input.

repairHints: Check min/max on the target port if a value appears clamped.
